title: Ashley Desktop Design System
intent: A responsive personal social hub presented as an original Classic Mac OS 8/9-inspired desktop.
principles: Navigation first: every profile is a real link and works without JavaScript.
Use recognizable desktop interface objects rather than decorative cards.
Give Twitter, Bluesky, Threads, GitHub, LinkedIn, and Instagram equal weight.
Keep Easter eggs optional, accessible, and positive.
Preserve WCAG 2.2 AA contrast, visible focus, keyboard access, and reduced motion.

motion.reducedMotion: Disable starfield animation and do not activate After Dark.

depth.style: Hard-edged raised and recessed platinum chrome; no soft shadows.

components.menuBar: Sticky platinum system bar with AW icon, compact navigation, and clock.
components.window: Striped title bar, raised frame, paper or chrome content, and optional status bar.
components.finderList: Six equal profile rows with platform badge, name, handle, file kind, and open indicator.
components.desktopShortcut: Original AW-themed glyph with a keyboard-focusable label.
components.readMe: Positive yellow note about curiosity, community, and finding Ashley online.
components.secretAbout: Native dialog opened by five AW-logo activations; Escape closes and restores focus.

responsive.smallScreen: Stack windows in document flow and collapse secondary Finder metadata before primary labels.
responsive.overflow: Horizontal document overflow is not permitted.

interaction.wallpaper: Shift-click blank desktop space or press Shift+W.
interaction.afterDark: Enter the Konami sequence; unavailable when reduced motion is requested.
interaction.announcements: Use an aria-live region for wallpaper and mode changes.

content.tone: Playful, candid, confident, curious, and platform-neutral.
